newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan to scrap limit of one stock exchange in bid to gain entry to World Trade Organisation.
One out of every 14.7 marriages ends in divorce, government statistics show.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Provincial governor James Soong reiterates opposition to cancellation of provincial government.
Miaoli council member Hu Ming-shing detained for suspected vote-buying.
LIBERTY TIMES - Colin Powell says United States will maintain pledge to upkeep Taiwan's safety.
Vice President Lien Chan meets Powell, urges U.S. to supply Taiwan with military weapons.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Mainland China hints it may delay approval of Taiwan's offshore transshipment centre scheme, which would allow direct cross-strait shipping links.
Taiwan revises law requiring workers to inform management of upcoming strikes.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Foreign funds investment in Taiwan stocks total T$600 billion in past four years.
Japanese exports soar in February on yen depreciation.
